added.name: @smthrs/cli
added.reason: Pinned corrected OpenTUI native artifact path for source and published TUI bootstrap through the existing setRenderLibPath seam. Node resolves the packaged file; Bun embeds the same file in compiled distribution. Help and print remain lazy; unsupported or missing artifacts refuse instead of selecting an unpatched library. See vendor/opentui-native/README.md and issue #2403.

added.name: @smthrs/testing
added.reason: Shared bounded explicit-column process-table probes for real-process tests; a separate Node-only subpath keeps browser test hosts independent of child_process.

added.name: @smthrs/canonical
added.reason: Runtime-free entry for the existing exact canonical serializer and errors, used by browser and Worker wire contracts without importing the Effect schema. No digest algorithm or output change; the package tests prove a dependency-free browser bundle.

added.name: @smthrs/platform-node
added.reason: Shared transient process ownership for build commands, model runners, discovery and services. The public wrapper preserves target status, literal pipe IO and native Windows arguments; the private supervisor protocol stays internal. Durable host ledger composition remains in NodeHost.

added.name: @smthrs/canonical
added.reason: Shared bounded JSON admission and encoded-byte accounting used by flow, run-store, and step-cache; explicitly re-exported and documented by canonical. Persistence-specific error vocabulary remains with each caller.

added.name: @smthrs/memory
added.reason: Host-composable memory migration set and installation layer on the shared durable database ladder. NodeControl composes this public set with lower engine/control blocks; SQL schema implementation remains private.

added.name: @smthrs/engine-store
added.reason: Intentional public journal-to-deferred/clock rebuild port (#2054), exposed by engine-store's source and publication maps, barrel and API reference. Journal records carry references and digests only; completion values stay in their rows, and an unjoinable reference fails fold_incomplete.

added.name: @smthrs/engine-store
added.reason: Intentional public journal-to-step-cache head rebuild port introduced in 9ed6aa98c50e5990eda6d3072e8c7649632995af (#2053), explicitly exposed by engine-store's source and publication maps, barrel and API reference. Cache results remain in the append-only recorded ledger; ambiguous, compacted or rewound history refuses rebuilt heads. Retention limitations remain tracked in #2053.

added.name: @smthrs/engine-store
added.reason: Deliberate public revisioned execution observation port, documented in engine-store's observe-executions guide and API reference; reviewed in execution-snapshots.md. Internal SQL readers remain private.

added.name: @smthrs/engine-store
added.reason: Deliberate public bounded revision catch-up port with durable deletion tombstones, documented in engine-store's observe-executions guide and API reference; reviewed in execution-snapshots.md.

added.name: @smthrs/journal
added.reason: The injectable journal ownership strategy introduced in 3ff0127860c48343447492e2601715e88e43794f (#2055) owns exclusive claims, exact activation grants, monotone heartbeats, evidence-bound stale takeover and commit-time fences; run-store Ownership delegates to this service while preserving its existing API. The public barrel and owner-fence guide intentionally expose the strategy for deployments and browser/local embedding; reviewed under #3183 with shared consensus conformance and fenced journal boundary tests.

added.name: @smthrs/journal
added.reason: The default SQL implementation of journal Consensus introduced in 3ff0127860c48343447492e2601715e88e43794f (#2055) arbitrates the private flows_consensus_leases table through DurableWriter and participates in commit-time journal fences. The public barrel and owner-fence guide intentionally expose make/layer for host composition; reviewed under #3183 with real database conformance, displaced-writer refusal and persistence-failure tests; existing journal exports remain recorded.

added.name: @smthrs/journal
added.reason: Shared versioned engine event schemas and explicit consumer admission, documented in journal's state-event-authority guide; reviewed in state-event-contracts.md. Additive contracts do not cut over existing writers or expose engine projection internals.

added.name: @smthrs/control
added.reason: Host-owned approval authority, distinct from authenticated principal attribution and workflow capability grants; enforced before mutation/replay and at decision commit.

added.name: @smthrs/control
added.reason: Read port from the control plane into a host's trigger store, so Control.list answers the triggers and fires variants; the port lives in control because @smthrs/triggers already depends on it, and layerNone is the typed refusal for a host without a store.

added.name: @smthrs/triggers
added.reason: Adapter that serves the @smthrs/control DispatchReader port from a TriggerStore, so a host composes Control.list triggers and fires over the same store the scheduler writes; the adapter lives here because only this package can read the store.

added.name: @smthrs/engine-store
added.reason: Authoritative owner-fenced merge intent/completion state. Required on the scheduler's database so a stopped attempt and its atomic plan/input extension survive recovery independently of redacted journal projections.

added.name: @smthrs/engine-store
added.reason: The replay-only engine (1587e5f24a) behind smthrs runs verify: it serves recorded steps and reports the first step a resume would execute, running no action body.

added.name: @smthrs/engine-store
added.reason: Authoritative owner-fenced input observations for durable plan execution; explicitly composed on the run database, separate from approval plans, redacted journal projections and evictable caches.

added.name: @smthrs/plan
added.reason: Shared ready-work priority, aging and capacity policy; deliberately public for execution adapters. Does not execute effects or determine conditional readiness.

added.name: @smthrs/scorers
added.reason: Pure runtime grading contract extracted from testing so published evaluations do not execute a test package; testing delegates with unchanged verdicts and error identity.

added.name: @smthrs/canonical
added.reason: Retains main's safe own-property record operations.

added.name: @smthrs/journal
added.reason: Retains main's generation-aware journal cursor contract.

added.name: @smthrs/kernel
added.reason: Retains main's declared child-process environment policy.

added.name: @smthrs/kernel
added.reason: Binds filesystem, path and process services to one root so hosts serve a directory other than the process cwd; apps/tui/src/host.ts imports it (#2201).

added.name: @smthrs/std
added.reason: Checkpoint input relocation for the supported read and shell flows, including explicit refusal of writes, absolute paths and parent traversal. Covered by Relocate.test.ts against the owning flow input schemas.

added.name: @smthrs/build-cli
added.reason: Declaration-derived target listing and text rendering used by the index command; keeps planning, host state and cache digests out of the committed metadata contract.

added.name: @smthrs/flows
added.reason: Shared durable runtime with injected host and SQL services; NodeRuntime and BunRuntime preserve the same native API over it.

added.name: @smthrs/flows
added.reason: Bun lifecycle and database composition over the shared runtime; imported only through its explicit Bun entrypoint.

added.name: @smthrs/database

added.name: @smthrs/model

added.name: @smthrs/model
added.reason: USD rate cards generated from the backend price table (#1840); @smthrs/agent Budget prices usage records through it.

added.name: @smthrs/engine-store
added.reason: Shared persisted journal event names already exposed by current main; replay consumers use this stable identity vocabulary.

added.name: @smthrs/gateway
added.reason: Bun adapter already exposed by current main for the authenticated gateway; it preserves the same protocol and policy as the Node host.

added.name: @smthrs/control
added.reason: Documented public Health namespace for Effect checks, bounded observation policies, provenance and shared status rollup, re-exported by control/src/index.ts and consumed by gateway. This adds the public contract without exposing private projection state or changing prior runtime entries.

added.name: @smthrs/canonical
added.reason: Existing main export centralizing Effect Schema issue-path formatting used by control validation. Retains the previous validation-path behavior; record the shared entry without changing the original baseline.

added.name: @smthrs/canonical
added.reason: Existing main export for a copied immutable map facade used by filesystem and plugin views. It preserves read semantics without exposing source-map mutation; record the shared entry in the explicit surface audit.

added.name: @smthrs/model
added.reason: Typed questions over JSON state, answered by Jev through the Evaluator service and decoded into probabilities and confidence; the classifier declaration the classify flows are built from.

added.name: @smthrs/model
added.reason: The Jev transport service: the Vercel AI Gateway layer, a scripted layer for tests, and the unavailable layer a host without a key installs.

added.name: @smthrs/platform-node
added.reason: The one constructor for the outbound Undici client a Node process should use: it routes through the egress proxy HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY name and is the plain pool when they name none. Every host composition installs it instead of NodeHttpClient.layerUndici, whose bare Agent dials every origin directly and is dropped by a default-deny sandbox. A separate subpath keeps it reachable without importing the jj-bearing host bundle.

added.name: @smthrs/plan
added.reason: The one effect envelope model, relocated here from @smthrs/core so a single declaration serves the plan compiler, the flow graph builder and the pattern library.

added.name: @smthrs/plan
added.reason: The one placement model and its annotation key, relocated here from @smthrs/core so the typed directive and the key @smthrs/flow annotates with are the same declaration.

added.name: @smthrs/plan
added.reason: Draft and compile fixtures shared with @smthrs/plan-store, which drives them against the persisted form. The same test-support convention as @smthrs/database's ./test/TestDatabase.

added.name: @smthrs/plan
added.reason: The one cache-policy declaration: the scope vocabulary, the policy schema, the annotation key @smthrs/engine-store reads at dispatch, and the annotator. It was declared twice, in @smthrs/flow and @smthrs/patterns, tied together only by a re-typed identifier string; @smthrs/plan is the package both already depend on. The identifier is unchanged, so every policy already written is still read.

added.name: @smthrs/plan
added.reason: The one bounded-repetition ceiling vocabulary, taken by @smthrs/flow Poll as onTimeout and @smthrs/patterns Loop as onMaxReached. It was the same two literals written out in both packages with no edge between them.

added.name: @smthrs/agent
added.reason: Explicit offline completion-judge fixture shared by whole-host tests. It rejects unknown questions and malformed evidence; production hosts must supply their configured evaluator.

added.name: @smthrs/agent
added.reason: Jev seat and system-variant routing added in #1929; the TUI host and the native equipment supply its Catalog. A declared seat always wins, and an unanswerable judge fails the run as SeatUnrouted instead of picking a default seat.

added.name: @smthrs/agent
added.reason: Cell plugin that teaches the core agent Smithers through the existing cellModelRequest and cellFlows hooks; the TUI composes it. It adds no second flow model and reaches flow runs only through host-supplied ports.

added.name: @smthrs/harness
added.reason: Shared completion evidence schema and classifier used by the offline scripted judge and native host completion gates.

added.name: @smthrs/harness
added.reason: The one metered, fail-closed Jev reader added in #1929; @smthrs/agent and the TUI host ask every supervisor, relevance, compaction, monitor and routing question through it. A host with no Evaluator fails the reading instead of guessing.

added.name: @smthrs/harness
added.reason: Declarative supervisor monitors added in #1929; @smthrs/agent composes them into the supervisor reading and gates delivery at the recorded steering drain against a durable ledger. Monitors are silent by default.

added.name: @smthrs/harness
added.reason: The Jev relevance gate added in #1929 for memory rows, catalog flows, skills and instruction-file chunks; @smthrs/agent applies it. An item is withheld only at P(unnecessary) >= 0.9, and an unjudged reading keeps everything.

added.name: @smthrs/harness
added.reason: The non-blocking Jev supervisor: its snapshot schema, classifier, thresholds and memory port, read by the offline SWE-bench replay and by hosts that adapt a memory store to it.

added.name: @smthrs/std
added.reason: Container-side directory measurement shared by bash mutation accounting and host workspace observations.

added.name: @smthrs/crypto

added.name: @smthrs/gateway
added.reason: Portable run-trace projection and step expansion shared by the browser and terminal run monitors.

added.reason: The frozen incident facts a Runaway or Stuck guard parks a run on, and the Timeout failure Stop settles it with, so a restarted host presents and decides the incident it was made on (#2120).

added.name: @smthrs/model
added.reason: Model-backed Evaluator judgments with the same answer validation as a resolved seat, and a transport-only fallback that consults the backup only when the primary is unavailable; the CLI composes it as Jev's GPT-6 Luna backup (4da531c75).

added.name: @smthrs/engine
added.reason: The injected table a composing host uses to bind a flow's serializable Flow.Placement target to Here or to a Proxy engine; with no table every placement runs here, as before (2ed052e5a).

added.reason: The argv-prefix Sandbox.Provider: commands, reads and writes travel through nothing, ssh <args> or docker exec -i <container>, so a session reaches a remote host such as a Smithers Cloud workspace (6d08bf3b2).

added.name: @smthrs/agent
added.reason: The memory capability as one sealed flow a cell calls with ctx.call("memory", ...): deterministic seeds and shortlists over the wiki, a README-guided repository walk, commits and facts, each kept by one Jev boolean; hosts bind it with plugin and run opening before frame 0 (5b745c566).

added.name: @smthrs/agent
added.reason: The threshold math behind every memory routing decision: cost-derived thresholds over calibrated Jev probabilities, and the bounded refit memory/calibrate runs, which refuses moves past maxMove or fits on too few labels (5b745c566).

added.name: @smthrs/agent
added.reason: Mines a finished run's transcript once for durable facts and steering decisions, judged by one Jev reading, and is the one redacted writer of a mined fact; the memory/mine file flow reads it (45e4f3ca6).

added.reason: Built-in deterministic scoring required by #1849: normalized equality/containment, sandbox command exit verdicts with inconclusive launch failures, and unified-diff line/file budgets. Uses existing scorer identities, durable runner observations and sandbox Session; rubric delegates to the existing Rubric contract.

added.name: @smthrs/registry
added.reason: Typed MDX prompt compiler and concrete Component<Props>/Content authoring contract; compilation parses without evaluating expressions. Existing captured-module loader retains content checks and authority. Reviewed upstream 3017c54ddf (#2271), public Node/Bun rendering and concrete-prop consumer controls; admitted under #3184 without changing the original 48-package surface.

added.name: @smthrs/registry
added.reason: Text JSX runtime explicitly required by compiled typed MDX prompts; Fragment/jsx/jsxs/render produce Markdown, with no second flow or host model. Reviewed upstream 3017c54ddf (#2271), public Node/Bun rendering and concrete-prop consumer controls; admitted under #3184 without changing the original 48-package surface.

added.name: @smthrs/kernel
added.reason: Kernel host confinement service and conservative effective-grant Profile derivation. makeNoop/layerNoop explicitly opt out; missing service refuses guarded spawning, with no implied native confinement. Reviewed upstream 6490adb4c2 (#3140/#1790/#3234), source/docs, public import/type controls and owning native tests under #3184; original 48-package history retained.

added.name: @smthrs/platform-node
added.reason: Node host implementation of the kernel seam: default missing-mechanism refusal, explicit warned unconfined option, scoped temporary lifecycle and shell/pipeline wrapping; no second execution model. Reviewed upstream 6490adb4c2 (#3140/#1790/#3234), source/docs, public import/type controls and owning native tests under #3184; original 48-package history retained.

added.name: @smthrs/platform-node
added.reason: Shared native mechanism selection/planning/wrapping for declared build inputs and guarded agent profiles; concrete refusal types and host probes preserve enforced-or-refused behavior. Reviewed upstream 6490adb4c2 (#3140/#1790/#3234), source/docs, public import/type controls and owning native tests under #3184; original 48-package history retained.

added.name: @smthrs/patterns
added.reason: Reviewed upstream cb79039728 declaration: canonical Flow pattern plus claimed bounded round, ordered landing, release-on-failure and capacity wait/resume helpers. It adds one explicit subpath over the existing @smthrs/flow model; it does not authorize issue claims, provider credentials or history writes by itself. Required injected callbacks remain the host authority.
